questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of an iterative design process?
options: To build the product only once
To improve a design through repeated testing and refining
questions.explanation: An iterative process involves cycling through design, build, and test stages to continuously improve the outcome.

questions.question_text: What is the main benefit of using an iterative design process?
options: To avoid testing the product at all
To constantly refine and improve a design through repeated testing and feedback
To ensure the product is only made from plastic
To reduce the cost of marketing
questions.explanation: Iteration involves repeating the cycle of prototyping, testing, and refining to ensure the final product is as good as possible.

questions.question_text: What is the primary benefit of an iterative design process?
options: It guarantees the product will be cheap
It allows for continuous improvement through testing and feedback
It ensures the product is only made once
It removes the need for sketching
questions.explanation: An iterative process involves repeating cycles of prototyping and testing to refine the final product based on user needs.
